nodes.label: DOTween Tweening Library (DG.Tweening)
nodes.author: Daniele Giardini (Demigiant)
nodes.rationale: Tweening engine for Unity (copyright 2014-2026 Demigiant); modules activated/deactivated via DOTween Utility Panel (Tools > Demigiant > DOTween Utility Panel, Setup DOTween... button); upgrading from <1.2.815 requires overwriting files in Plugins/Demigiant and reopening Unity without safe mode.
